svg.aria-label: Gradient descent drawn as a contour map of error over two dials, with three walkers: one parked in a dip, one at the bottom, one crawling across a flat
svg.title: Gradient descent drawn as a contour map of error over two dials, with three walkers: one parked in a dip, one at the bottom, one crawling across a flat
svg.text: (any two of a few hundred billion, the rest held still for the picture)
a dip: the slope reads zero, so it stops,
the deep basin a few rings away, unseen
a flat: the rings are far apart,
and each step shrinks to a crawl
